entry.name: mc.peek~
entry.description: Use peek~ to read and write sample values to a named buffer~. Unlike related objects index~ and poke~, values and indices are specified as Max messages, and the object will function even when the audio is not turned on.

messages.name: clip
messages.description: If set to 1, then values written to thewill be clipped to within -1.0 to 1.0. Disable by setting to 0.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Floating-point values are converted tovalues.In left inlet: Set the sample to be stored.In right inlet: Set the buffer channel.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The value stored at the specified sample-index is sent out theobject's outlet. However, if a value has just been received in the middle inlet,stores that value in theat the specified sample index instead. If the sample-index is out of range for the, no data is read or written.

messages.name: list
messages.description: The value is stored in theat the specified sample-index and buffer-channel. If the buffer-channel is omitted, the most recent channel is used. If the sample-index is out of range for the, no data is written.
